role.altitude: The Payroll Specialist stops doing the monthly matching and data entry and becomes the person who designs and maintains Noordhaven's pay checks: the pre-run exception rules, the reconciliation tolerances, and the CAO rule variants for both CAOs and the flex population. They gain the right to block a pay run or a payment batch on an exception and to change check thresholds with the Controller, so the job becomes more expert, not less.
reach: Accountant: post and close the payroll journals and clearing accounts in the AFAS general ledger at month end (needs: accrual and journal logic, period-close calendar)
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: prepare the yearly gender pay gap figures and answer individual pay transparency requests (needs: EU 2023/970 rules, job-scheme set-up in AFAS)
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: own the Power BI payroll and labour-cost pages built on the AFAS extract (needs: Power BI data modelling, DAX basics)
HR Administrator: check contract and mutation data entered in AFAS before it reaches the pay run (needs: contract templates and CAO scale rules)
role.ceiling_note: Of the roughly 480 hours a year in these seven tasks, about half can go, mostly matching, re-keying and report building; the floor is set by work that cannot be handed to a model: signing off a run, judging CAO and tax edge cases, answering employees about their own pay, and carrying legal liability for the filings. Generated gross-to-net is out of bounds, so savings depend on AFAS rules and deterministic checks, not on model output.
skills_to_grow: Writing pay-check rules and tolerances as explicit, testable logic (AFAS signals, Excel or a small script built with AI coding)
Reading and encoding both CAOs and flex-worker pay rules (ABU/NBBU phases as applied by the three agencies) as rule variants
EU pay transparency and AI Act duties as they hit payroll (Art. 50 disclosure, AVG Art. 22 human review)
Power BI modelling on the AFAS extract
Explaining checks and exceptions to the works council, the Controller and auditors
role.ambitious_version: Run a first-time-right payroll service with a published monthly scorecard (corrections per run, retro adjustments, unmatched bank items), extended to flex workers by checking agency hours and invoices against Noordhaven's own shift data before they are paid. Add a pay-explanation service where employees and managers get a disclosed AI answer that quotes the actual AFAS calculation, with a route to the specialist for any challenge.

tasks.short: Close each pay run: match AFAS payments to the Rabobank statement and make the period-end report.

today.trigger: A monthly or four-weekly pay run is paid out and the Rabobank statement for the payment date comes in.
steps: Export the payment batch and the payroll journal from AFAS Profit
Download the Rabobank statement and match net pay, loonheffing and pension premium payments line by line in Excel
Chase rejected or returned payments (wrong IBAN, leavers) and reissue them
Build the period-end summary per site and cost centre for the Controller
drudgery: Line-by-line matching of hundreds of net pay transfers
Re-keying totals into the period-end Excel
today.time_sinks: Hunting for small differences caused by returned payments, split batches and manual off-cycle payments.

lenses.faster: Matching and the summary are generated by rules from the AFAS batch and the bank file; the specialist only reviews the unmatched list and signs, about 1.5 hours instead of 6 per run.
lenses.autonomous: Arrival of the Rabobank statement starts the match; matched lines close themselves, and differences above a set tolerance wait for the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile daily instead of per run, so a returned payment to a warehouse worker is reissued the next day rather than at the next close; demand would grow because off-cycle payments become cheap to control.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses ticking off transfers in Excel; the specialist wants more time on why differences happen and fixing the cause in AFAS.
lenses.options: Little value in multiple drafts; the match is right or wrong.
lenses.altitude: The specialist sets matching rules and tolerances with the Controller and owns sign-off of the payroll part of the period close.
reach: Accountant: post the payroll clearing journal in the AFAS ledger
Bookkeeper: handle returned payments in the bank booking

tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a difference is a timing issue, a bank error or a real overpayment, and calling the employee or bank about it.
tasks.pattern_why: Matching payments to a statement follows fixed keys (amount, IBAN, reference, date), so rules work and no model is needed.

in_practice.trigger: Rabobank statement file (MT940/CAMT) for the pay date lands in the finance folder.
steps: Load AFAS payment batch and the bank file
Match on reference, IBAN and amount; group by batch
List unmatched and returned items with likely cause
Produce the period-end summary per site and cost centre
Specialist reviews exceptions and signs off
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves the exception list and the period-end summary; Controller accepts it into the month close.
in_practice.logs_to: Reconciliation file per run on the finance SharePoint, with sign-off name and date

evidence.claim: Reconciliations in payroll should be deterministic software, not model output.
Payroll calculation and checks stay deterministic and rules-based in production.

risks: Tolerances set too wide hide real overpayments
Bank file format changes break the match silently
research_questions: How many lines per run stay unmatched today, and what share are returned payments versus off-cycle payments?
Can AFAS Profit export the payment batch with a reference that appears unchanged on the Rabobank statement?
Does the Controller accept a rule-based sign-off as audit evidence?

tasks.short: Run the monthly and four-weekly payroll in AFAS, check it, and publish payslips.

today.trigger: Payroll calendar date for the monthly (office) or four-weekly (shift) run.
steps: Collect mutations: new starters, leavers, shift allowances, overtime, absence
Run the trial calculation in AFAS Profit
Compare against last period in Excel and investigate big moves
Final run, payment batch to Rabobank, payslips to the AFAS employee portal
drudgery: Scanning trial-run comparisons for outliers by eye
today.time_sinks: Explaining and fixing outliers in shift allowances and flex conversions just before the deadline.

lenses.faster: AFAS still calculates; a check layer flags exceptions (gross moved too much, pension stopped while enrolled, leaver paid twice, rate under minimum wage) and a model writes a one-line explanation for each, so the trial-run review drops from a day to a few hours.
lenses.autonomous: The trial run triggers the checks; clean employees pass, flagged ones wait for the specialist, and the final run and payment batch need their approval.
lenses.ambitious: Run the same checks on every off-cycle and correction run, not only the main runs, for the night and weekend shift population where allowance errors cluster; demand grows as each extra check run costs minutes.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses eyeballing a 750-row variance sheet; the specialist wants more time fixing root causes with the HR Administrators and managers.
lenses.options: Not applicable: a pay run has one correct result.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the check rules and thresholds and can hold any employee's pay or the whole run on an exception.
reach: HR Administrator: catch wrong contract or scale entries before the run
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: spot CAO scale errors in the checks

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a flagged pay change is right given what they know of the person, the shift pattern and the CAO, and owning the decision to release pay.
tasks.pattern_why: Gross-to-net and the checks are rules in AFAS and a script; one model call only turns each flagged exception into a readable explanation for review.

in_practice.trigger: Trial calculation completed in AFAS Profit for a pay period.
steps: Export trial results and last period's results
Run rule-based checks per employee
Model writes a short explanation per exception from the wage-component history
Specialist resolves exceptions and approves the final run
AFAS publishes payslips and creates the Rabobank batch
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves each exception and releases the final run and payment batch.
in_practice.logs_to: Exception log per run (check, explanation, decision, approver) on payroll SharePoint

evidence.claim: Production pre-run checks: gross moved more than expected, pension stopped for an enrolled person, leaver paid double, hourly rate under minimum wage; calculation stays deterministic.
Workday's Payroll Agent will flag items outside defined parameters for payroll to check (roadmap).

risks: A plausible but wrong explanation leads the specialist to wave through an error
Too many flags cause alert fatigue
Exporting personnel pay data to a model needs AVG processing terms and possibly works council consent
research_questions: How many corrections per run does Noordhaven make today, and which would the four standard checks have caught?
Can AFAS Profit export trial results and wage-component history automatically per run?
Does the works council see the check layer as needing consent under WOR 27?

tasks.short: Make the monthly pay and benefits reports for Finance, HR and site managers.

today.trigger: Month close, plus ad hoc requests from Finance, HR Business Partners or the OR.
steps: Export payroll journals and employee data from AFAS
Build labour cost, overtime, allowance and pension summaries in Excel
Check against the general ledger
Mail the files to Finance, HR and site managers
drudgery: Rebuilding the same pivot tables each month
Answering one-off 'can you split this by site' mails
today.time_sinks: Ad hoc requests that need a new cut of the data and a manual check against the ledger.

lenses.faster: Standard reports become fixed Power BI pages on the nightly AFAS extract with a ledger tie-out check; the specialist reviews the tie-out and comments on movements, about one hour instead of six.
lenses.autonomous: Nightly refresh and month-close status in AFAS trigger the pages; a tie-out failure stops publication until the specialist clears it.
lenses.ambitious: New service to the Compensation and Benefits Specialist and HR Director: the yearly gender pay gap report under the pay transparency bill (first over 2027 pay, due 7 June 2028) with the gap per job category; demand grows once it is cheap to rerun for scenarios.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses rebuilding pivots; the specialist wants to spend time explaining what moved and why.
lenses.options: Pay gap scenarios (by job category, site, with or without flex) change which gaps need a joint evaluation with the works council.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the definitions of payroll figures (what counts as labour cost, overtime, gap) and agrees them with Finance and HR.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: maintain the payroll pages in Power BI
FP&A Analyst: supply actual labour cost per site for forecasts

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which figure a manager actually needs and spotting when a number is wrong for a business reason the data does not show.
tasks.pattern_why: Reports come from fixed definitions on structured AFAS data; a dashboard and a tie-out check do it without a model.

in_practice.trigger: Month close flag in AFAS and nightly Power BI refresh.
steps: Refresh the payroll model from the AFAS extract
Tie out totals to the general ledger payroll accounts
Publish pages per site and cost centre
Specialist adds a short commentary on material movements
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist releases the month's pages after the tie-out passes.
data_needed: Job schemes and sex for pay gap figures
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI refresh history and a tie-out sheet on the payroll SharePoint

evidence.claim: Noordhaven will report its gender pay gap yearly, first over 2027 pay, due 7 June 2028; a 5% unexplained gap triggers a joint evaluation with the works council.
AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes for pay transparency.

risks: Dashboards showing individual pay to the wrong audience (AVG)
Definitions drift between Finance and HR
research_questions: Which of today's monthly reports are actually opened by recipients?
Are job schemes in AFAS complete enough to compute pay gaps per category of equal work?
Does the nightly extract hold the fields needed for the ledger tie-out?

tasks.short: Balance the payroll clearing accounts in the ledger each month: net pay, wage tax, pension.

steps: Pull balances of payroll clearing accounts from the AFAS ledger
Match each to payroll journals and the payments made
Investigate and correct leftover balances
Hand the account specification to the Controller
drudgery: Tracing old open items month after month
today.time_sinks: Old open items from corrections and returned payments that nobody cleared.

lenses.faster: A rule-based specification ties each clearing balance to journals and payments and ages open items; the specialist only works the open items, about 2 hours instead of 6.
lenses.autonomous: Month-close triggers the specification; zero-balance accounts close themselves and open items above tolerance wait for the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Run the balance check weekly, so leftover balances are cleared within days and the Controller's month close is not held up by payroll; more frequent checks become worth it as they cost nothing to run.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses tracing year-old open items; the specialist wants to fix the process that creates them.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the payroll clearing accounts and agrees with the Controller when an item may be written off.
reach: Accountant: post correction journals for payroll accounts
Controller: prepare the payroll section of the close file

tasks.human_edge: Deciding what an old open item really is and whether to correct, reclaim or write it off.
tasks.pattern_why: Account balancing follows fixed links between journals, payments and accounts, so rules suffice.

in_practice.trigger: Month close in the AFAS ledger.
steps: Pull clearing account balances and journals
Match to payroll runs and bank payments
Age and list open items
Specialist clears items and signs the specification
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist signs the specification; write-offs need the Controller.
in_practice.logs_to: Monthly account specification on the finance SharePoint

evidence.claim: Reconciliations should be deterministic software at autonomy 4-5.

risks: Auto-closing small balances hides a repeating error
Split responsibility with the Accountants blurs who clears items
research_questions: How many open items sit on payroll clearing accounts now, and how old are they?
Who owns payroll account specifications today: payroll or the Accountants?

tasks.short: Process back pay and corrections: CAO increases with retro effect, missed allowances, past errors.

today.trigger: A new CAO wage increase with retro effect, a manager or employee reporting a pay error, or a late contract change.
steps: Read the request or CAO text and work out which employees and periods are affected
Enter retro mutations in AFAS Profit and let it recalculate
Check the retro result per employee in Excel
Inform the employee and record the reason
drudgery: Working out the affected group and periods by hand
today.time_sinks: Large CAO retro rounds covering hundreds of shift workers and checking every result.

lenses.faster: A model turns the incoming mail or CAO clause into a proposed mutation list (who, which periods, which component); AFAS calculates the retro; rule checks compare each result to the expected effect and a draft notice goes to the employee for the specialist to check.
lenses.autonomous: An incoming correction request or CAO change starts the draft; nothing enters AFAS until the specialist approves the mutation list.
lenses.ambitious: Serve flex workers for the first time: check agency invoices against the CAO increase so flex staff get the same retro uplift as employees and Noordhaven is not overbilled; demand grows with the 150-300 flex headcount.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses computing retro groups in Excel; the specialist wants more time on the hard cases and talking to the employee.
lenses.options: For a disputed error, two or three correction routes (one-off back pay, spread over periods, net versus gross correction) change the employee's tax and allowance outcome, so drafting them side by side helps the decision.
lenses.altitude: The specialist decides how each correction is done and holds the record of why, which matters under AVG Art. 22 review.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: translate CAO increases into AFAS scale tables
HR Business Partner: explain corrections to managers

tasks.human_edge: Reading CAO intent where the text is unclear, judging fairness in a disputed error, and telling a worker their pay was wrong.
tasks.pattern_why: The steps are fixed; only the intake (mail or CAO clause into a structured mutation list) and the notice draft need a model, while AFAS does the maths.

in_practice.trigger: Correction mail in the payroll mailbox or a published CAO increase.
steps: Model extracts employees, periods and components into a mutation list
Specialist approves the list
AFAS runs the retro calculation
Rule checks compare results to expected deltas
Model drafts the employee notice; specialist edits and sends
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves the mutation list before entry and each notice before it is sent.
in_practice.logs_to: Correction register with reason, approver and notice, in AFAS dossier

evidence.claim: Workday's Payroll Agent will audit retroactive adjustments and draft employee notices for payroll to check (roadmap, early 2027).
Rule-based pay decisions need a route to human review.

risks: Model misreads the affected group in a CAO clause
Notices that sound final before the employee can object
Works council consent if the model reads personnel files
research_questions: How many retro corrections per year come from CAO increases versus individual errors?
How accurately does a model extract employee groups and periods from past CAO texts and correction mails?
Do the staffing agencies pass on CAO increases on time, and how is that checked today?

tasks.short: File the monthly loonaangifte with the Belastingdienst and send corrections when needed.

today.trigger: Monthly filing deadline after each pay period, and corrections after retro changes.
steps: Generate the loonaangifte in AFAS Profit after the run
Check totals against the payroll journal
Submit and process the Belastingdienst response
Send correction messages for earlier periods when pay changed
drudgery: Comparing filing totals to journals by hand
today.time_sinks: Correction messages after retro pay and resolving rejected filings.

lenses.faster: AFAS builds the filing; a script ties filing totals to journals and lists which past periods need a correction, so the specialist only reviews differences and submits, about half the time.
lenses.autonomous: Run close triggers the filing build and tie-out; submission waits for the specialist's approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check filings for every off-cycle and correction run before submission, cutting penalties and Belastingdienst queries; demand would not grow much because filing volume is fixed.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses manual tie-outs; the specialist wants more time understanding tax treatment of allowances and flex conversions.
lenses.options: Not applicable: the filing has one correct content.
lenses.altitude: The specialist remains legally responsible for filings and decides on correction timing and treatment of unclear items with the Controller.
reach: Accountant: book wage tax payments and accruals
Controller: answer Belastingdienst audit queries on payroll

tasks.human_edge: Judging tax treatment of unusual items (allowances, expense reimbursements, werkkostenregeling) and dealing with the Belastingdienst.
tasks.pattern_why: The filing is generated by AFAS from fixed rules, and the tie-out is a rule check; a model adds risk without benefit.

in_practice.trigger: Final pay run closed in AFAS Profit.
steps: AFAS generates the loonaangifte
Script ties totals to the journal and flags periods needing correction
Specialist reviews and submits
Response logged and rejections routed back
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves every submission and correction.
in_practice.logs_to: Filing register with submission and response in AFAS

evidence.claim: Filings are deterministic software, not LLM work.
'Almost right means someone gets paid incorrectly'; generated payroll figures are unacceptable.

risks: Over-trust in the tie-out misses wrong tax tables
research_questions: How many filing corrections and rejections did Noordhaven have in the past year?
Can AFAS report which past periods are affected by a retro change?

tasks.short: Handle pension fund, UWV and insurance forms and mutations for employees.

today.trigger: New starter, leaver, contract change, long-term sickness, or a request from the pension fund, UWV or an employee.
steps: Receive form or request by mail or post
Check data against AFAS records
Enter mutations or complete the form (pension fund, UWV, employer statements)
Send and file in the personnel dossier
drudgery: Copying data from PDFs into portals and AFAS
Filling the same employer statements repeatedly
today.time_sinks: Missing data that requires chasing HR Administrators or the employee, and different rules per CAO and pension fund.

lenses.faster: A model reads the incoming form or mail, fills the fields, and checks them against AFAS records; the specialist reviews flagged mismatches and submits, cutting typing and checking time by about half.
lenses.autonomous: An incoming document in the payroll mailbox starts intake; filled forms wait in a queue for approval before submission or entry.
lenses.ambitious: Offer flex workers who convert to employment a checked pension and insurance start in their first pay run, instead of fixes months later; demand grows with each seasonal conversion wave.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses retyping PDFs; the specialist wants more time helping employees with pension and sickness questions.
lenses.altitude: The specialist sets which document types go through intake and what counts as a mismatch, and handles the cases with judgment.
reach: HR Administrator: file and check personnel dossier documents
HR Business Partner: prepare UWV paperwork in Poortwachter cases

tasks.human_edge: Handling sensitive cases (long-term sickness under Wet verbetering poortwachter, death, divorce pension splits) and talking to the employee.
tasks.pattern_why: Messy documents need one model call to become structured fields that are then checked against AFAS in a fixed workflow.

in_practice.trigger: Form or request arrives in the payroll mailbox or the AFAS dossier.
steps: Model classifies the document and extracts fields
Rules compare fields to AFAS records
Specialist approves or corrects
Submit to portal or enter in AFAS and file
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves each filled form or mutation before it is sent or saved.
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS personnel dossier with the source document and approver

evidence.claim: Timesheet and leave documents fit an llm_step intake.
A bot reading the personnel file needs works council consent (WOR 27(1)(k)).

risks: Medical data in sickness documents processed by a model breaches AVG special-category rules
Extraction errors in pension data cause wrong premiums for years
research_questions: Which document types make up most of the volume, and how many arrive per month?
Can medical details be kept out of the model's input for UWV documents?
Will the works council consent to model intake on dossier documents?
